note: On `normal` the prior-year (REGION, PERIOD) group is a row only in the actual REGION_ATTAINMENT, which names no column because nothing in it is NULL; on `period_end` the same group also reaches ATTAINMENT_HISTORY, where it overwrites a history row. The `empty` and `edge` sets have no prior-year group and pass.

The merge matches a region's other periods: the before-row for WEST 2025-12 is overwritten by WEST 2026-01's values and a region's second period is never inserted. compile_check.py refuses this build (write_mode: the MERGE must match on exactly the objective's keys), so only a validation run catches it here and the orchestrator's fix-loop scenario never serves it. Which of a region's periods survives is not deterministic (a MERGE with two source rows for one target row), so the two runs of the idempotency check can differ: this is the one broken build whose report may say idempotent: false.
